section.title: FactorGcf — monomial GCF only
section.blurb: D=0 is $6x+9 \to 3(2x+3)$. At D≥8 the GCF includes $x$ (old $4x(2x-3)$), not the same $3x+6$ at every D. Opt out with use_factor_poly=True.
